title: State-aware Method Flow witness promotion
failure_signature: Two explicit validated-state requests were rejected because each passing witness had already advanced its candidate method to validated.
trigger_preconditions: caller assumes witness and validated transition are separate
state operations batched before returned state is inspected
candidate_workaround: Record one witness, inspect its returned method_state, and request preferred only when the witness has already produced validated.
recurrence_guard: Do not batch witness and redundant validated transitions; branch the next operation on the runner's returned state.
rollback: Retain the rejected transition, leave the witness and current valid state intact, and issue no compensating edit to the append-only ledger.
scope_boundary: Method Flow runner sequencing only; not evidence for repository completeness or any scientific or authority claim.
